title: Average Score
description:
Given `scores = {"math": 90, "english": 85, "science": 92}`, print the average score.

**Expected output:**
```
89.0
```
starterCode:
scores = {"math": 90, "english": 85, "science": 92}
# Calculate and print average score
hint: Use sum(scores.values()) / len(scores) to compute the average.
